name: Atago Yui
source:
Class: 2-E

[url=/c130985]Shouko[/url]'s childhood friend who stopped coming to school after the video where Yui gets bullied went viral. She refuses to leave her house, being afraid of what other people will say to her. Perhaps due to her current emotional state, she snaps more at people and is very gloomy.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1245143]Getchu[/url]]
